answer: When dawn opens epoch 128, a key may berth at the public wharf only by starting a metered lease that accrues 2 POA per hour in umber stamps on the public tape. Eight hours fill the watch, so each key owes 16 POA at close, paid to the wharf account; unused hours still come due. The tape lists the berth, the umber stamps, and the dawn start, so anyone can add eight stamps and confirm the 16 POA due. A farm of 380 keys that keeps 380 berths owes 380 x 16 = 6,080 POA the attacker forfeits.
